components.title: Microbiological attributes
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Microbiological attributes of the dosage form, where appropriate (sterility, bioburden, preservation, antimicrobial effectiveness). CONTRACT: If not applicable for solid oral dosage form, state N/A with brief justification per source. PRESENTATION: Plain text.
